paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Depth
model_annotation: The line plot titled “Prompt Depth vs Accuracy” illustrates the relationship between prompt depth (measured in units labeled as “J” on the x-axis) and model accuracy (expressed as a percentage on the y-axis) for two methods: “mmsd” and “mmsd2.” The x-axis spans from approximately 1 to 11, with major tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis ranges from 74% to 81%, with tick marks every 1%. The “mmsd” method is represented by an orange dashed line with square markers; it begins near 80.0% accuracy at prompt depth 1, remains relatively stable around 80.1–80.2% through depth 7, peaks at approximately 81.2% at depth 9, then declines slightly to about 80.1% at depth 11. The “mmsd2” method is shown as a solid blue line with circular markers; it starts at approximately 76.5% at depth 1, dips to 74.0% at depth 3, then rises steadily to 77.6% at depth 7, plateaus near 77.7% at depth 9, and falls slightly to 76.8% at depth 11. The legend in the lower right corner identifies the two lines by name and visual style.
